title: Returned-Payment Fee Amount — LandlordGuard Fee Tariff
content:
**Tariff rule.** The LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy returned-payment fee is the returned-fee basis plus the returned-fee adjustment, multiplied by the return-frequency factor, never below 0.00, rounded half-up to the cent once on the final figure. The standard returned-fee basis is the tier's returned-payment fee, the standard returned-fee adjustment is zero and the standard return-frequency factor is 1.

## Condition, arithmetic, result

- **Inputs:** the returned-fee basis, the returned-fee adjustment and the return-frequency factor.
- **Arithmetic:** basis and adjustment are added; the sum is multiplied by the return-frequency factor; a negative result is taken as 0.00.
- **Result:** rounded half-up to the cent once, at the end.

## Worked figures (hypothetical tier fees)

| Tier's returned-payment fee taken as | Basis | Adjustment | Return-frequency factor | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 25.00 USD | 25.00 | 0.00 | 1 | 25.00 USD |
| 20.00 USD | 20.00 | 0.00 | 1 | 20.00 USD |
